name: SDP My Account Tabs for WooCommerce
author: Simple Direct Plugins

sections.description:
SDP My Account Tabs for WooCommerce lets you fully customize the WooCommerce My Account page by adding, reordering, and renaming tabs. You can display dynamic user-related information, including WordPress profile data (name, avatar, registration date, bio, website, and any custom user meta key) and WooCommerce details (billing/shipping info, orders, total spent, coupons, purchased products, among others).

The plugin also includes a flexible shortcode to display any user meta key, allowing developers and site owners to output custom fields added by themes or plugins without additional coding.

The plugin automatically detects any custom tabs added to the WooCommerce My Account page by third-party plugins —such as Bookings, Subscriptions, EU VAT Number, and others— and integrates them seamlessly. This ensures that all tabs, whether native or added by external plugins, are fully compatible and manageable within the SDP My Account Tabs interface.

In the Pro version, you can also insert dynamic data from WooCommerce Subscriptions, WooCommerce Memberships, WooCommerce Bookings, WooCommerce EU VAT Number, and BuddyPress, giving you ultimate control over the My Account experience for each user.

⚙️ Features

  • Add custom tabs to WooCommerce My Account page.
  • Reorder tabs using a drag-and-drop interface.
  • Rename WooCommerce core and third-party plugins tabs.
  • Hide WooCommerce core and third-party plugins tabs.
  • Add custom content or shortcodes to tabs.
  • Display dynamic user data:
    • WordPress: name, avatar, registration date, bio, website, any custom user meta key, and more.
    • WooCommerce: billing/shipping info, orders, total spent, available coupons, purchased products, and much more.
  • Shortcode to display any WordPress user meta key.
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce core endpoints (Orders, Downloads, Addresses, etc.).
  • Detects and supports custom My Account tabs created by other plugins
  • Integrates with payment methods.
  • Translations ready.
  • Completely translated into Spanish.

💎 Pro Version

Unlock the full potential of SDP My Account Tabs Pro with these advanced features:

  • Create conditional tabs for specific user roles, individual users, purchased products, or active memberships (WooCommerce Memberships).
  • Display user-specific data from WooCommerce Subscriptions, WooCommerce Memberships, WooCommerce Bookings, WooCommerce EU VAT Number, and BuddyPress.
  • Priority support and updates.

Upgrade now to provide a tailored, data-rich My Account experience for your users!
sections.faq:
Can the plugin be translated into other languages?

Yes, it’s fully compatible with translation files and multilingual plugins such as WPML, and comes with a complete Spanish translation included.
